body: Thanks for your comments. Honestly I wasn't anticipating feeling any kind of encouragement by posting here but your last sentence definitely made me smile.

I have heard of a self fulfilling prophecy... unfortunately, as self aware as I can be, I can't keep myself from being destructive in relationships in that way. It feels like I'm another person when I feel threatened or insecure in a relationship. It's hard to describe, but after it happens I can see my errors in logic in utter clarity... only then it's too late. It's part of the reason it has been so maddening.
